convert_3d_mocap: convert 3D mocap data from HumanEva .mat files to compressed .npz format
convert_2d_detections: convert user-supplied 2D pose detections from .avi.npz files to compressed .npz format
split_train_validate: split HumanEva subjects into train and validate sets using predefined frame index ranges
sync_camera_streams: synchronize multi-camera video streams using per-subject, per-action, per-camera frame offsets
chunk_corrupted_sequences: split corrupted motion capture sequences into contiguous valid chunks based on finite-value checks
